title: generator.reading.v1
description: A measured periodic reading from a DSE genset controller (engine hours, running state, fuel level, fault). Measured data from the controller, not a fabricated sensor. Advisory only — the platform monitors and alerts, it never controls a genset. See docs/feature-plans/GENERATOR_MONITORING.md (FP-11).

reading_id.description: Deterministic id so replay/backfill of the same reading is idempotent.

engine_hours.description: Measured cumulative engine hours; null if the controller does not report it.

fuel_level_pct.description: Measured fuel level (%); null if not reported.

expected_running.description: The schedule/controller intent; when false and running is true, an unexpected-run alarm is raised.

measured.description: This reading carries measured controller values, not estimates.
